result.title: Meta-RTL: Evolving Agent Harnesses for RTL Optimization
result.summary: Large language models enable agents to optimize RTL using EDA feedback, yet their executable search procedures remain largely hand- engineered. We present Meta-RTL, an EDA-grounded framework that evolves RTL optimization harnesses from a minimal loop while keeping the optimization model, EDA flow, and per-design budgets fixed. Compared with Dr. RTL, Meta-RTL* reduces aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 7.8%/11.0% across 20 development designs, with area reductions on 70% of them. Without further evolution, Meta-RTL* transfers to 10 unseen IC-RTL designs, reducing aggregate WNS/TNS violations by 20.5%/14.0% and total synthesized area by 12.6%. We further characterize three search mechanisms in the evolved harness and assess their contributions through ablations and a case study.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 Meta-RTL，在优化模型、EDA 流程与单设计预算固定下，从最小循环出发用 EDA 反馈自动演化 RTL 优化 agent 的执行搜索流程，并报告迁移效果与搜索机制消融。
